title: 整理手上的牌
question:
玩撲克牌時，每拿到一張牌，就把它插到手上適當的位置，手上的牌一直都是由小到大排好的，這就是插入排序。
請先輸入有幾張牌，再一張一張輸入牌的點數。每拿到一張，就輸出一次手上的牌（整個清單）。

en.title: Sort Your Cards
en.question:
When you play cards, you put each new card in the right place. Your hand is always sorted from small to big. This is insertion sort.
First input the number of cards. Then input the cards one by one. After each card, output your whole hand.
